$comment: Where each screen's data can come from (Settings > Screens; ported from the panel lab's screen catalogue). Per screen: shows (what the screen shows, in words: its settings page opens with it), needs (the equipment in words, null = every home), sources in order of preference. A source: id, kind (builtin = worked out on the panel, ha = a Home Assistant integration or entity domain, direct = the panel calls a service itself), name, detect (how a host's discovery finds it: integration and / or domain), setup (what a direct source needs first), fills (which screen parameters it fills: domain [+ integration] -> every matching entity (list: true, a comma list) or one). The host (the hub, later a Home Assistant integration) runs discovery and writes the values into the panel's deck. Feeds (CONTRACT.md C51, 2026-10-29): feed = the panel.<feed> entity the screen binds; each source names the adapter that fills it (core/<feed>_source.cpp), set through the feeds settings of the spec.

media.shows: What is playing on a speaker: the track, artist and progress, with play, pause, skip and volume.

bins.shows: Which bins go out next and when, with the collections after it.

sources.name: Any Home Assistant calendar (a council iCal added as a Remote calendar)
Council calendar link (iCal), read by the panel itself (planned)

calendar.shows: The events coming up from your calendars, as an agenda or a month.

sources.name: Calendar link (iCal), read by the panel itself (planned)

weather.shows: The weather now and the forecast for the hours and days ahead.

sources.name: Open-Meteo, called by the panel itself (planned)

energy.shows: Today's energy use by the half hour with its rates, and the last two weeks.

sources.name: Energy sensors in the panel energy shape (sensor.panel_energy + sensor.panel_energy_days, filled by Home Assistant from a tariff integration such as Octopus Energy)

thermostat.shows: The heating: the room temperature, the target to set, the mode and preset.

covers.shows: Your blinds and curtains: how open each one is, to open, close or set.

lock.shows: A door lock: locked or not, to lock and unlock it.

vacuum.shows: The robot vacuum: what it is doing, its battery, the room and progress, to start, pause or dock it.

sources.name: Roborock (its status, error, room, progress, time and area sensors)

plants.shows: How moist each plant's soil is, and which ones need water.

cameras.shows: Your cameras' latest pictures and what they detected.

light.shows: One light: on or off and its brightness.

print.shows: The 3D printer: the print, its progress and time left.

lightning.shows: A lightning strike: how far away it was and when.

github.shows: Your pull requests: open, waiting for review and their checks.

sources.name: A pull request sensor in the panel github shape (filled by Home Assistant from the GitHub API)
GitHub API, read by the panel itself (planned: needs the panel's HTTPS client)

timer.shows: Timers you set on the panel or in Home Assistant, counting down.

clock.shows: The time and date, with the weather under it.

agents.shows: What your AI agents are doing: busy, waiting or done.
agents.needs: AI agents that report their status

overhead.shows: The aircraft flying over your home right now.

flightradar.shows: The aircraft around your home on a radar, with the ones to come.

sources.name: An aircraft sensor in the panel overhead shape (sensor.panel_overhead, polled by Home Assistant)
adsb.fi (open ADS-B, no key), read by the panel itself (planned)

living_room.shows: The lights of one room, to switch and dim each one.

strike_map.shows: Lightning strikes near you on a map, the newest brightest.

moon.shows: The moon tonight: its phase, rise and set, and the next full moon.
